cases.prompt: Write a headless Isaac Sim script that opens a USD and saves a diagnostic JSON file.
cases.expected_behavior: Creates SimulationApp before Omniverse imports, uses headless mode, records stage and artifact paths, and closes the app.

cases.prompt: My standalone script fails importing omni.usd.
cases.expected_behavior: Checks whether SimulationApp was created before runtime imports and routes startup failures to runtime/troubleshooting skills.
